meta.description: Pimple Gurav is the closest area to our New Sangvi head office. JEE coaching with faculty from Kota, from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

h1: IIT JEE coaching in Pimple Gurav
intro: Pimple Gurav is the closest area to our head office: about {{commute:pimple-gurav#km}} km to Krishna Nagar, New Sangvi.

sections.heading: A short trip to New Sangvi

body.text: Take Kate Puram Road and the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.

body: At about {{commute:pimple-gurav#km}} km, it is close enough to walk.

body.text: Students from three Pimple Gurav schools study with us: Mar Ivanios Convent High School, Kilbil High School and The New Millennium School.
If you know the Rajmata Jijau Garden, the Dinosaur Park, you are already close to us.
The two-year programme starts after Class 10; the one-year programme is for Class 12. Batches have {{fact:batch.size}} students at most.

questions.q: How far is the head office from Pimple Gurav?
questions.a: About {{commute:pimple-gurav#km}} km, the shortest trip of any area we list.

questions.q: Do students from Pimple Gurav schools study with you?

a.text: Yes: from Mar Ivanios Convent High School, Kilbil High School and The New Millennium School.

questions.q: Can my child study at the centre after class?
questions.a: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} is at the head office. Ask us about the times it is open.
